capabilities: Render dot and graphviz code blocks as SVG diagrams in reading view and Live Preview
Draw diagrams from .dot or .gv files in the vault and redraw when the file changes
Show error messages with the line number when Graphviz cannot parse a block
Copy diagrams to the clipboard and export them as SVG or PNG (Pro)
Open notes by selecting linked diagram nodes (Pro)
disambiguation: Not for Mermaid diagrams; it renders only the Graphviz DOT language.
extras: Freemium: offline rendering, theme colors, file-based diagrams and three engines are free; node-note links, SVG/PNG export, four more engines and style presets are Pro. After updates the plugin opens a promotional tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be turned off). Layout runs on the main thread; blocks over the edge limit (default 300 edges) are not drawn. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later.
intentEvidence: The Kroki plugin sends your block to a Kroki server, so it needs a network or your own server.
problem: Obsidian renders Mermaid code blocks but has no built-in way to draw Graphviz DOT diagrams, and other approaches need a server or a local Graphviz install.
